events.body:
## Context

Icon-only buttons (hamburger in `UI/index.html` and `UI/status_health.html`, identity-bar close) have no `aria-label`, so screen readers read the ligature text ("menu", "close"). Several buttons do nothing ("Review", "View All 15 Rooms", an `alert('coming soon')`). `status_health.html` never checks `r.ok` on `fetch('/status')` and its catch only logs, so the list stays on "Loading rooms..." forever.

## What to do

1. Add `aria-label`s and `aria-hidden` on the icon spans.
2. Hide or disable stub buttons.
3. Check `r.ok` and render an error state in the catch.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No "button has no name" in Lighthouse
- [ ] A failing `/status` shows an error, not a spinner

## How to test locally

```bash
cd blt-hackerhouse && npm install && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply hackerhouse --local && uv run pywrangler dev
```
